description: Canoe-kayak: a former high-level athlete and multiple-time French champion who was a member of the French national team and competed at European and World level; she frequently invokes the sporting values of effort, perseverance and collective engagement.

Long-standing focus on local security and public tranquillity (tranquillite publique), the portfolio she held as first deputy mayor and retained personally as mayor; security and prevention of delinquency is a central pillar of her 2026 program.

Advocacy for ecological transition, biodiversity and soft mobility (active mobility / cycling), reflecting her role as first vice-president of Dijon metropole in charge of mobilites actives and the cycling plan.
